title: Darbar ich Zahra Nay Ditiya Nay Sadawaan
body:
Ki khoob kitiyan nay teray baad mera Baba umat nay wafawaan
<<DIVIDER>>
Jehray loka nay Kal baba kita na haya tera
Aj kerday ki oh mera
Lut lainiyan aehna nay Kulsoom tay Zainab day Haye sir toun ridawaan
<<DIVIDER>>
Jehray Hasbona day Kal tak kerday si baray daway ona nu pae samjhaway
Laraib main Quran aan ayat e muqadas nay
aey meriyan saawaan
<<DIVIDER>>
Enj teri wasiyat nu pamal rahay kerday Rab toun vi nahin darday
Tehreer day tukray main ro ro kay chuna baba
nalaye akhiyan tay laawaan
